description: This file defines the VariadicExpression class, which extends ArrayExpression, within Twig's expression node namespace. It provides functionality related to variadic expressions in Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\VariadicExpression
classes.description: A class representing a variadic expression node in Twig's internal expression AST, extending ArrayExpression and adding a compile method to output variadic syntax.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the variadic expression by outputting '...' followed by the parent class's compile output, enabling variadic argument syntax in generated PHP code.
